### S122-01 Contact quality bind — UI (+Logic)
**Test file path**: `src/ProjectAegis.Delegation.Tests/Projection/ContactDetailProjectionTests.cs`; UnityAdapter host/UXML contracts under `src/ProjectAegis.Delegation.UnityAdapter.Tests/Bridge/`
